nodes.description: Public token name string, set to 'Spic of Wall Street' in the constructor.
Public token symbol string, set to 'SPIC' in the constructor.
Public uint8 decimals value, fixed at 18.
Public total token supply minted in the constructor.
Mapping(address => uint) holding token balances of every account.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of owner to spender allowances.
Caller-supplied address used to mint, debit, credit and authorize allowances.
Constructor that sets name, symbol, decimals, mints _totalSupply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
SafeMath addition returning a+b after requiring no overflow.
SafeMath subtraction returning a-b after requiring b <= a.
SafeMath multiplication returning a*b with overflow require.
SafeMath division returning a/b after requiring b > 0.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
Returns balances[tokenOwner] for the queried account.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender] for the queried pair.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[to] using SafeMath.
Debits balances[from], reduces allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits balances[to] using SafeMath.
State-changing subtraction balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) inside transfer.
State-changing addition balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transfer.
State-changing subtraction balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens) inside transferFrom.
State-changing subtraction allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) inside transferFrom.
State-changing addition balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transferFrom.
Unchecked arithmetic _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply.
Arithmetic c = a + b with post-condition require(c >= a) in safeAdd.
Arithmetic require(b <= a); c = a - b in safeSub.
Arithmetic c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b) in safeMul.
Arithmetic require(b > 0); c = a / b in safeDiv.
